integrity.claim_scope: All n>=3, indexed three-one binary words; exact cut classification and population formulas.
integrity.computational_support: Standalone exhaustive comparison by KMP and direct prefix-suffix methods, not substituted for proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct classification of all possible proper borders, followed by gap-composition counting and exact moment algebra.
integrity.scientific_review_limits: Same-model assessment only; no independent mathematical review.

limitations: Exact three-one, binary, ordinary-border setting only; no assertion for larger Hamming weights or Abelian borders.
Unrestricted upper bounds and fully bordered structure are known; the new claim is the complete local correlation and fixed-weight distribution.
Available textual inspection of the 2003 technical-report PDF did not include visual-page retrieval; its journal version was not inspected independently.
Historical-priority search may miss unindexed equivalents; mathematical audit by an independent party has not been performed.
title: Three-gap law for the unbordered-conjugate correlation of binary words
